mapper.select: SELECT m.type, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS material_count, SUM(m.total_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN m.status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.status = 'WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warning_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.status = 'STOP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stop_count FROM raw_material m WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.type ORDER BY m.type
